limitations_and_boundaries: Experiments performed in embryonic chicken skin; applicability to mammalian hair follicles not directly tested.
Pharmacological manipulations may have off-target effects; blebbistatin and calyculin A effects on proliferation were ruled out, but other pathways not assessed.
Substrate stiffness experiments used polyacrylamide gels; in vivo mechanical environment may differ.
Short-term contraction assay (2 hours) suggests posttranscriptional response, but transcriptional contributions not excluded.
Rescue of bmp2 expression with BIO confirms β-catenin dependence but does not exclude other parallel mechanosensitive pathways.
